items.cite: *Open Music Theory* (online undergraduate textbook and workbook).
items.note: A freely accessible teaching resource intended for undergraduate music-theory study.

items.cite: William E. Caplin, *Classical Form: A Theory of Formal Functions for the Instrumental Music of Haydn, Mozart, and Beethoven* (Oxford University Press, 1998).
items.note: Analyses the functions of phrases, themes and larger formal units, developing ideas from Schoenberg and Erwin Ratz.

items.cite: James Hepokoski and Warren Darcy, *Elements of Sonata Theory: Norms, Types, and Deformations in the Late-Eighteenth-Century Sonata* (Oxford University Press, 2006; paperback 2011).
items.note: Distinguishes five sonata types and examines transitions, medial caesuras, cadential closure and recapitulation as historically conditioned choices.
